title: Tenma Saki — Unseen Assistance〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Don't Let Doubts Hold You Back

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's dig in!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe... It feels like it's been so long since the four of us had lunch together like this!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We were all so busy practicing for the recital and didn't have any time to meet.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right. But now that it's over, we can finally get together for lunch again.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Especially you, Hona! You did such a good job!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I was thinking... Why not throw a Job-Well-Done Party at my house for your reward!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A Job-Well-Done Party?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't be fooled. She just wants an excuse to have fun is all.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: N-No way! I would never dream of using Hona for my own purposes!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Seems suspicious.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Actually, I don't mind.
It's been a while since we all hung out too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yesss! Okay, after we finish band practice this weekend, we'll head straight to my house!
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let Hona's Job-Well-Done Party begin!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
And to start off, allow me to say...
Great job on the choir recital, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you. You all did great too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, let's do this... Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Shiho, & Honami
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A lot did happen, but the recital sort of just breezed by in the end.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. We didn't win the gold either, but at least we all got to work together on something again!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I wish we could look back on the recital like we did with all the pictures everyone took during the Sports Festival.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Only choir recital committee members were allowed to film the actual recital so...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Actually, I have a few photos. I asked a friend on the committee to take them for me because I really wanted something memorable.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I knew we could count on you, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Don't worry, all of you are in the photos.
Let's see... Oh, here!.
This is Shiho's class singing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah it is! And there's Shiho!
You seem really into it too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
What do you mean seem?
Everyone would know if we lip-synced.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, this is our class!
Hehe. Saki was trying so hard...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I really wanted to win gold!
But Hona's class was way too good.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They really were something else.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I agree. They definitely deserved to win.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Whoa... It's pretty late.
I have to go to work soon.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shall we call it a day?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wish we could keep going, but I guess we should.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I'll take care of cleaning up too.
Just leave your cups and snacks wherever.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
We can't make you clean up by yourself.
I'll take the cups to the kitchen.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'll help too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay. Saki and I can sort out the remaining snacks.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And we can split the leftovers between us!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Good idea.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um, Hona?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hm? Yes?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This may sound weird, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Did I help?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Remember how I kept going on about you not being alone because you have us...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it feels like I couldn't really do anything to help you in the end...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I wasn't there for you for most of junior high because I was in the hospital.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Did you throw this party for me because of that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well, um... I really can't hide anything from you, can I? Does that mean Ichi and Shiho knew too?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I'm pretty sure they did.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
But you don't have to worry, Saki.
You were a big help by just being yourself.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The same goes for Ichika and Shiho. I was able to face this problem head-on because you were all there for me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So that's what was bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I thought so.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey! You two heard all that?!
And what do you mean, I thought so?
You were all onto me...?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
How long have we known each other?
But you might be giving us too much credit too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: B-But I had to know if I was at least able to contribute a little after talking so big...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, it's that! I'm just trying to take responsibility for what I said!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I appreciate that, Saki. And thank you too, Ichika and Shiho. I couldn't have done this without all of you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe. You're welcome...!
